spellbook.finance/limitations: This reads ManaPool live, so the answer is true at generatedAt and not after. A sale on any channel between this call and the apply invalidates the previewToken, and the apply says so instead of acting on a stale plan.
Actions listed are the actionable ones only. An unchanged listing is omitted, and on a mature book that is most of it, so a short list is the normal case. summary still counts the whole book.
truncated true means the list was capped and omittedActionCount says by how much. The summary is still complete.

A delist action only ever appears for a listing SpellBook can match. A live ManaPool listing with no matching local row is reported as blocked, never delisted, because this tool cannot remove a listing it does not understand.
It needs a connected ManaPool account. When spellbook_manapool_connection_status reads not connected, get the setup page from spellbook_manapool_connect_link and guide the seller through it first.

description: Compare one workspace's inventory against what is live on ManaPool, and return the exact changes a sync would make. Every action is listed with its kind: upsert to create or change a listing, delist to remove one, blocked where a cross-channel check refused it. Nothing is sent to ManaPool by this call. Show the person the summary and the counts, then call spellbook_manapool_sync_apply with the previewToken this returns.

floorUsd.description: A price floor in USD for this preview. Omit to use the workspace's stored floor.

multiplier.description: Price multiplier applied to market price for this preview. Omit to use the workspace's stored pricing.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to compare against live ManaPool state. Required.

name: spellbook_manapool_sync_preview
